metadata.name: Soul Collector Class Tree
metadata.description: The Soul Collector's sigil: a hanging lantern holding souls. Fervour is the light, hung in the centre pane between the two inner bars, and the Reaper's Road climbs those bars and the cap's ribs to the top of the cap. Hoard and Burn are the cap's slopes, the ring it hangs from and a soul drifting down each side pane. Harvest and Siphon are the outer posts, a soul rising in each side pane and the pointed finial beneath, Hungry for the Strong at its point. The Siphon stands on the right inner bar below the light, opposite Gleaning. The four vows stand in a column on the left. Positions only: every node and edge is the revised tree's.

data.name: Fervour
data.description: Kills generate Fervour, taken from the dead: 1 for each enemy you kill, 3 for an Elite, 5 for a Legendary, 8 for a Herald and 15 for a Boss. You deal 1% more damage for every 2 Fervour you hold. While you have this, Fervour decays at 5 per second once 4 seconds have passed since your last kill, until you kill again, so a pause between kills is what empties it. Killing an Elite or stronger creature holds off the decay for 8 seconds rather than 4.

data.name: Tithe of the Dead
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from kills per point.

data.name: Last Breath
data.description: Each kill restores 1% of your maximum health for every 2 points.

data.name: Weight of Souls
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for every 50 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Grave Patience
data.description: Your Fervour begins to decay 1 second later after a kill for every 5 points.

data.name: Between the Dead
data.description: +1% increased Movement Speed per point for 4 seconds after you kill, so you reach the next pack before your Fervour begins to decay.

data.name: Pale Ward
data.description: +1% increased Damage Reduction per point for every 100 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Claimed
data.description: An enemy you hit gives you its Fervour if it dies within 1 second for every 2 points of that hit, whatever kills it.

data.name: Deep Urn
data.description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Soul Fuel
data.description: Your skills that have a cooldown, other than movement skills, spend up to 10 Fervour when you use them, and deal +1% increased damage for every 4 points for each Fervour they spend.

data.name: Held Close
data.description: +3% increased Crowd Control Resistance per point while you hold 50 or more Fervour. Crowd control stops your kills, and stopped kills let your Fervour decay.

data.name: Death's Toll
data.description: Enemies your minions, gadgets and traps kill give you their Fervour, and count as your kills for everything this tree asks.

data.name: Reclaimed
data.description: A kill made after your Fervour has begun to decay gives back the Fervour that decay took from you in the 3 seconds before it.

data.name: Soulbound
data.description: Your Fervour no longer decays with time. Instead you lose 1 Fervour for every 2% of your maximum health that you lose to damage.

data.name: Ossuary
data.description: +2% increased maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Gathered Weight
data.description: +1% increased Area of Effect per point for every 40 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Chained Souls
data.description: 8% per point of the Fervour your minions, gadgets and traps hold back counts as Fervour you hold, for everything that counts Fervour held.

data.name: Cold Precision
data.description: +1% increased Critical Strike Multiplier per point for every 50 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Brimming
data.description: +1% increased Attack Speed per point while you hold 50 or more Fervour.

data.name: Full Measure
data.description: +2% increased damage per point while your Fervour is at its maximum.

data.name: Hoarded Life
data.description: +1% increased Health Regeneration per point for every 20 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Miser's Grip
data.description: Your Fervour never decays below 3% of your maximum Fervour per point.

data.name: Cold Storage
data.description: Your Fervour decays 5% slower per point.

data.name: Generous Count
data.description: Each Fervour threshold is reached 1 Fervour sooner per point.

data.name: Steady Count
data.description: +1% increased damage per point for each Fervour threshold you are at or above.

data.name: Overflow
data.description: Fervour gained above the maximum becomes 5 seconds of attack speed. Each Fervour above it gives 1% increased Attack Speed for 5 seconds, up to 30%.

data.name: Hoarder
data.description: You lose 50% less Fervour to decay.

data.name: Long Shadow
data.description: Each Fervour threshold you reach stays in effect for 5 seconds after you fall below it.

data.name: Gleaning
data.description: Each enemy you kill has a 5% chance per point to give 1 extra Fervour.

data.name: Empty Hands
data.description: +2% increased Attack Speed per point while you hold fewer than 20 Fervour, to fill the bar again quickly.

data.name: Thinning the Herd
data.description: Each kill gives +1% increased Fervour per point for every other enemy within 8 metres of you, up to 10 enemies.

data.name: Kill Chain
data.description: Kills within 2 seconds of each other form a chain. +1% increased damage for every 2 points for each kill in your current chain, up to 10 kills.

data.name: Unbroken Chain
data.description: A chain of kills allows 1 second more between kills for every 4 points. The same applies to Soul Tide.

data.name: Grim Wake
data.description: Enemies within 3 metres of an enemy you kill take 2% increased damage from you per point for 3 seconds.

data.name: Quarry
data.description: +2% increased damage per point against Elite and stronger creatures, which give the most Fervour.

data.name: Tear Loose
data.description: Your hits on an Elite or stronger creature have a 2% chance per point to give you 1 Fervour, torn from it.

data.name: Vigil Over the Strong
data.description: While an Elite or stronger creature is within 15 metres of you, your Fervour decays 5% slower per point.

data.name: Any Fuel
data.description: +2% increased Fervour gained from sources other than kills per point, so another class's way of filling the bar fills it faster.

data.name: Borrowed Time
data.description: Each time you gain Fervour from a source other than a kill, the time before your Fervour begins to decay is extended by 1 second for every 3 points, never past its full length.

data.name: Passed On
data.description: Half the damage your hit deals beyond what killing an enemy needed is dealt to every other enemy within 3 metres of it. A kill this makes passes on its own excess the same way.

data.name: Hungry for the Strong
data.description: Elite and stronger creatures give 100% more Fervour.

data.name: Kindred Fires
data.description: Fervour you gain from any source, not only a kill, holds off decay as a kill does: the time before your Fervour begins to decay starts again.

data.name: The Siphon
data.description: You siphon every enemy within 6 metres of you. The enemies in your Siphon are what the other nodes of this limb act on, and what a skill that names your Siphon reads. Without this keystone you have no Siphon.

data.name: Sapping Cold
data.description: Each enemy in your Siphon deals 1% reduced damage per point and has 3% reduced Movement Speed and Attack Speed for every 2 points, and you gain +1% increased damage and +1% increased Movement Speed for every 2 points for each of them, up to 10 enemies.

data.name: Pall of Souls
data.description: +1% increased area of your Siphon per point for every 20 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Life Siphon
data.description: At 10 points: each enemy in your Siphon restores 1% of your maximum health each second, up to 5 enemies.

data.name: Drain
data.description: Your Siphon deals damage over time to every enemy in it: 2% of your weapon damage per point each second, as Death damage.

data.name: Necrotic Siphon
data.description: An enemy that has been in your Siphon for 3 seconds has a 5% chance per point each second to be given Necrosis.

data.name: Enfeeble
data.description: Enemies in your Siphon deal a further 1% reduced damage per point.

data.name: Stolen Strength
data.description: +1% increased Damage Reduction for every 4 points for each enemy in your Siphon, up to 10 enemies.

data.name: Soul-Heavy Air
data.description: Enemies in your Siphon take 1% increased damage from you per point for every 50 Fervour you hold.

data.name: Lingering Pull
data.description: Enemies stay in your Siphon for 1 second for every 4 points after they leave its area.

data.name: Reaching Cold
data.description: +4% increased area of your Siphon per point.

data.name: Living Harvest
data.description: Each enemy in your Siphon gives you 1 Fervour every 2 seconds, up to 4 Fervour a second. This Fervour does not come from kills, so on its own it does not hold off decay.

data.name: Deathly Presence
data.description: For every 10 Fervour held, enemies within 6 metres deal 1% less damage.

data.name: The First Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 25 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent. Reaching 25 points also opens the first Fervour threshold: while you hold 20 or more Fervour, all your skills have 20% more Area of Effect.

options.name: Soul Tide
options.description: Kills within 2 seconds of each other give 1 extra Fervour each, so chains of kills fill the bar fast.

options.name: Reaper's Due
options.description: Each hit on a Boss gives 5 Fervour (at most twice a second), and Fervour does not decay while a Boss is within 15 metres.

options.name: Swift Reaper
options.description: +2% increased Movement Speed for every 10 Fervour held.

data.name: The Second Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 50 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent. Reaching 50 points also opens the second Fervour threshold: while you hold 40 or more Fervour, all your skills fire one extra projectile or chain one extra time.

options.name: Second Wind
options.description: Reaching a full bar refills your health and mana, once every 60 seconds.

options.name: Spirit Volley
options.description: Each Fervour you gain from a kill flies to you as a spirit that strikes the nearest enemy on its way for 30% of weapon damage. Kills make spirits, spirits make kills.

options.name: Death's Focus
options.description: +1% critical strike chance for every 20 Fervour held.

data.name: The Third Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 100 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent. Reaching 100 points also opens the third Fervour threshold: while you hold 60 or more Fervour, your skills cost no mana.

options.name: Phylactery
options.description: A blow that would kill you instead spends all your Fervour (at least 50) and leaves you at that many percent of your health. Once every 60 seconds.

options.name: Reaper's Edge
options.description: Your hits kill a non-Boss enemy below 15% health outright, and those kills give double Fervour.

options.name: Soul Haste
options.description: +3% increased Attack Speed for every 10 Fervour held.

data.name: The Final Vow
data.description: Unlocks at 200 points spent. Choose one. The choice is permanent. Reaching 200 points also opens the fourth Fervour threshold: while you hold 100 or more Fervour, a full bar at the base maximum, your skill cooldowns recover twice as fast.

options.name: Wearer of the Dead
options.description: Killing an Elite or stronger creature gives you its modifiers for 20 seconds.

options.name: The Ferryman
options.description: While your bar is full, every enemy you kill bursts for 10% of its maximum health to enemies within 4 metres, and a creature the burst kills bursts too.

data.name: Spent Breath
data.description: +3% increased damage per point for 4 seconds after you spend 10 or more Fervour at once.

data.name: Deeper Draw
data.description: Your skills spend 1 more Fervour per point, up to 20 Fervour a skill.

data.name: Quick Kindling
data.description: +1% increased Cooldown Reduction per point for 4 seconds after you spend Fervour.

data.name: Pyre
data.description: Skills that spend Fervour have +1% increased Area of Effect per point for every 5 Fervour they spend.

data.name: Soul Shatter
data.description: Skills that spend Fervour have +4% increased Critical Strike Chance per point.

data.name: Final Rites
data.description: Skills that spend Fervour deal +3% increased damage per point against Elite and stronger creatures.

data.name: Soul Furnace
data.description: Spending 10 or more Fervour at once releases a blast dealing damage for each Fervour spent. The blast deals 10% of your weapon damage for each Fervour spent to every enemy within 5 metres.

data.name: Burnt Offering
data.description: You take 1% reduced damage per point for 4 seconds after you spend Fervour.

data.name: Spirit to Mana
data.description: Spending Fervour restores 1% of your maximum mana per point for every 10 Fervour spent.

data.name: Ashen Ward
data.description: Spending Fervour restores 1% of your Maximum Energy Shield per point for every 10 Fervour spent.

data.name: Feast
data.description: Spending Fervour heals 1% of maximum health for each Fervour spent.

data.name: Bound Offering
data.description: Fervour you hold back for a minion, gadget or trap counts as Fervour spent, at 15% per point of what is held back.

data.name: Cinders Kept
data.description: 3% per point of the Fervour you spend returns to you 4 seconds later.

data.name: Turn of the Wheel
data.description: Every 10 Fervour you spend takes 1 second off the cooldowns of your skills that did not spend it.
